## Website chatbot → n8n
The chatbot (web-chatbot-demo) POSTs every **confirmed** request here with the `X-Clinic-Secret` header, after saving it to Supabase.
n8n answers 202 at once so the chat never waits.

## Read the request
Gemini turns the free-text *when* and *details* into dates, times and fields that fit **that** business, plus a priority:
clinic = pain → urgent · restaurant = allergy / big party · agency = hot/warm/cold lead · hotel = arriving soon.

## One sheet tab per business, one Telegram alert
Clinic rows land in **Bookings** so the 09:00 reminders and 20:00 summary already include them.
